## Description

Combines evolutionary population-based training with multi-agent reinforcement learning to evolve robust market making quoting policies across competitive limit order book simulators.

## Where it may fit

Competitive limit order book market making, high-frequency liquidity provision under volatile spreads.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Crypto Prop Trading Desks.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book message feeds, trade execution logs, inventory position metrics.

## Caveats

Evolutionary reinforcement learning requires substantial GPU compute clusters for generational population runs.
